question.text: Distance between two non-intersecting planes <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math> and <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> is <math><mn>5</mn></math> units, where <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math> is <math><mn>2</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>6</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">z</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>26</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> and <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> is <math><mn>4</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">z</mi><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo></math> The point <math><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> lies between the planes <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math> and <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math>, then the value of <math><mn>3</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>5</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi></math> is equal to

solution.text:
Since both the planes are parallel
P1:4x-6y+12z+52=0
P2:4x-6y+12z+d=0
Therefore, d-5214=5⇒d-52=70
⇒d=122,-18
∴P2 is 4x-6y+12z+122=0 or
4x-6y+12z-18=0
Since the point -3,0,-1 is lying between P1 and P2
∴ On substituting the point in both the equations of the plane, both the expressions must be of opposite signs
Hence, 4x-6y+12z-18=0 is the equation of the required plane
